summary.title: Executive Summary — The Week in Numbers

blocks.label: The week in one line
blocks.text: Nifty 50 -0.22% · FPI equity -₹7,835 Cr · USD/INR 95.80 · Brent -0.71% · breadth mixed.
FPIs: a net equity outflow of ₹7,835 Cr across 4 NSDL reporting days (0 of 4 positive); debt -₹10,905 Cr.
USD/INR 95.80 (+0.11%, rupee weaker); Brent $103.87 (-0.71%); US 10-year 5.00% (+2 bp).
Nifty 50 -0.22% to 23,346.40, Midcap 150 +0.24%, Smallcap 250 -0.29% in the week to 18 Sep.

Of 1,557 coded names in the scan, 636 rose and 912 fell on the week (median -0.66%). Breadth regime: **mixed**, with 45.5% above the 50-DMA and 56.0% above the 200-DMA (-9.4 and -4.6 points over four weeks).
Stage 2 by calculation (all 7 template checks): 363 names, 37 entered and 54 left since 11 Sep. The provider's Stage 2 list (701 names) was not updated this week (the list on file is dated 13 Sep).

SwingEdge sub-sector trackers: 15 of 32 trackers rose. Led by CNC Machines (+6.97%), Battery Materials & Cells (+4.67%), Dyes & Pigments (H-acid, K-acid) (+3.20%); lagged by Sugar & Ethanol (-5.39%), Optical Fibre & Telecom Gear (-4.80%), Defence (-3.91%). The equal-weight market line: -0.51%.

blocks.label: How this report is built
blocks.text: Built automatically by `tools/auto_weekly.py` from data the evening pull already has: the screener.in scan, NSE's index file, NSDL's FPI Monitor, RBI's current rates, Yahoo closes, and SwingEdge's own breadth, Stage 2 and tracker files. No model writes any of it: each sentence is a template filled with the week's numbers. Not collected: DII daily flows and derivatives positioning (no keyless source). Facts only; nothing here rates a stock.
